decisions.reason: Either catalog option could affect badge-award behavior, but the client has not selected an option or specified the award trigger for a tenth badge or the relationship between Legend and the documented referral milestones.
The FAQ describes badge purpose and milestone-based awarding without stating the badge count, row layout, or Legend badge, so its current copy remains valid.
The About page only mentions badges and leaderboards generically; the badge-row catalog choice does not require changing that content.
The Mission page refers generically to badges and leaderboards and does not expose the number, row arrangement, or Legend badge.
The badge-row presentation decision is unrelated to the landing-page book cover's placement, size, crop, and visibility.
The badge catalog decision does not change the landing-page hero's headline, layout, CTA, subtitles, or visual emphasis.
The landing-page mechanics copy concerns referral commissions and prize messaging and contains no badge catalog or row-layout state.
Choosing a complete badge-row arrangement does not affect the current or planned product names.
Badge catalog presentation does not change referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The badge-row aesthetic decision has no effect on connected-wallet USDC mint behavior.
Badge catalog presentation does not alter the token standard, marketplace whitelist, or secondary-sale royalty rules.
Adding or removing a presentation badge does not change automatic prize delivery to winners' wallets.
